title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 04:22:07 最新章节：第四百七十八章 鸠占鹊巢一剑西来
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
许天是被一股浓烈馊味和推搡弄醒的。
意识到不对的他猛然睁眼。
映入眼帘的，不是医院。
而是一片灰蒙的天，和无数衣衫褴褛的背影。
“别挡道，快跟上！”
一只干枯手将他推了一个趔趄。
许天低头，看了看自己同样瘦得皮包骨的手。
一股不属于他的记忆汹涌而来。
自己大抵是穿越了。
原主也叫许天，生在乱世。
山下闹饥荒，易子而食。
听闻翻山宗招收杂役，管吃管住，便和一群难民涌了过来。
可惜，原主没能撑到山门，在拥挤的队伍中活活饿死。
“真是够倒霉的，死了这么久没发现。”
许天苦笑。
现在混在队伍中间，前后都挤满了人。
许天只能强打精神，跟着人流缓慢向前挪动。
半个时辰后。
队伍停在一个小广场。
“安静！”

一个穿着青色道袍的修士凌空而立。
并未张口，却能将声音传入每个人耳中。
“仙门仁慈，给尔等一个机会。现在开始测试。”
许天注视着凌空而立的修士。
这就是小说中写到的修真之人？
真装逼啊。
就在许天出神之际，测试已然开始。
很简单，仅有两步。
第一步。
检查健康。
一个中年管事挨个查看。
凡是身染重疾，或有残缺的，直接被驱赶下山。
轮到许天时，那管事皱眉看了他一眼：“瘦了点，勉勉强强。”
许天松了口气。
好歹算过关。
这一关看似简单，实则筛掉一半人。
第二步，测试灵根。
一块半人高的白色玉石立在广场中央。
“手放上去。”
青袍修士面无表情。
content_en:
Xu Tian was woken up by a strong sour smell and pushing.
Realizing something was wrong, he opened his eyes suddenly.
What caught my eye was not the hospital.
Instead, there was a gray sky and countless ragged figures.
"Don't block the way, follow quickly!"
A withered hand pushed him staggering.
Xu Tian lowered his head and looked at his own skinny hands.
A wave of memories that didn't belong to him surged over him.
I have probably traveled through time.
The original owner, also named Xu Tian, ​​was born in troubled times.
There was a famine at the foot of the mountain, so they exchanged their children for food.
Hearing that Fanshan Sect was recruiting handymen to take care of food and housing, he and a group of refugees came over.
Unfortunately, the original owner failed to reach the mountain gate and died of starvation in the crowded queue.
"It's really unlucky that he was dead for so long without being discovered."
Xu Tian smiled bitterly.
Now I am mixed in the middle of the queue, and there are people in front and behind.
Xu Tian could only brace himself and move forward slowly with the flow of people.
Half an hour later.
The procession stopped in a small square.
"Quiet!"
A monk wearing a blue robe stood in the sky.
He didn't even open his mouth, but his voice could reach everyone's ears.
"The Immortal Sect is merciful and gives you a chance. Let's start the test now."
Xu Tian stared at the monk standing in the sky.
Is this the cultivator written about in the novel?
What a show-off.
Just when Xu Tian was lost in thought, the test had already begun.
It's easy, just two steps.
first step.
Check your health.
A middle-aged steward checked them one by one.
Anyone who was seriously ill or disabled was driven down the mountain directly.
When it was Xu Tian's turn, the steward frowned and looked at him: "I'm a little thinner, just barely."
Xu Tian breathed a sigh of relief.
At least it’s a pass.
This level seems simple, but in fact it filters out half of the people.
The second step is to test the spiritual roots.
A white jade stone half a man's height stands in the center of the square.
"Put your hand up."
The green-robed monk had no expression on his face.
